title: Inference Profile RPC
description: Wire format for POST /predict_profile between the ml-inference HTTP service (:8080) and the backend InferenceClient. Nearest-cell semantics live ml-side (grid knowledge); the response returns the exact snapped cell coords used. Versioned interface — changes require a contract update.

temperatures.description: Temperature [degC] at the 15 canonical depths; null encodes land/NaN (never fabricated 0.0).

log_vars.description: Raw model log-variance [log(degC^2)] at the 15 canonical depths; null encodes land/NaN. Internal wire field — the backend converts to public sigma = sqrt(exp(log_var)) and never forwards this raw field.

latitude.description: Nearest-cell latitude actually used (grid snap of the requested lat).

longitude.description: Nearest-cell longitude actually used (grid snap of the requested lon).
